name: arith_even_gt_46_sum_two_abundant
statement: (n : ℕ) (he : Even n) (hn : 46 < n) : ∃ a b : ℕ, a.Abundant ∧ b.Abundant ∧ a + b = n
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (he : Even n) (hn : 46 < n), ∃ a b : ℕ, a.Abundant ∧ b.Abundant ∧ a + b = n
informal: Every even integer greater than 46 is a sum of two abundant numbers — Uses Mathlib2.ab_perfect_mul_abundant with Mathlib2.ab_perfect_six at the key step: every multiple 6k with k > 1 is abundant; split n mod 6: n = 12 + (n-12), n = 20 + (n-20), or n = 40 + (n-40) with 20, 40 abundant and the other summand a multiple of 6 that is ≥ 12.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), Even n → 46 < n → ∃ a b, a.Abundant ∧ b.Abundant ∧ a + b = n
